subject: Recap & MPA: SummitBridge pilot playbook, stakeholders, and timelines
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Ramos <alex.ramos@summitbridge.com>, Priya Nair <priya.nair@summitbridge.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 7 Jun 2027 14:02:00 -0400
Subject: Recap & MPA: SummitBridge pilot playbook, stakeholders, and timelines

Thanks again for the call this morning — good conversation and lots of alignment. I wanted to send a short recap and an initial Mutual Action Plan (attached) so we have a single source of truth for the pilot scope, owners, and decision milestones. Please review and suggest edits.

High-level pain & goals
- Pain: current in-house inference is inconsistent at scale (latency spikes during peak hours) and costs are unpredictable when burst capacity is needed.
- Regs: SummitBridge needs clear data handling boundaries (VPC/private deployment) for customer PII and auditability (SOC 2 evidence required).
- Goal: run a 6-week pilot that validates latency SLOs and per-unit cost improvements, with an evaluation rubric that maps to production rollout by Q4.

Success criteria (proposed)
1) Avg 95th-percentile latency <= 200ms for typical queries;
2) End-to-end per-request cost reduction >= 30% vs current baseline;
3) No major data residency gaps (VPC connectivity + proof-of-concept audit logs).

Proposed milestones / owners / dates (MPA v1 attached)
- Week 0 (by 2027-06-21): SOW sign-off & procurement intake — Owners: Priya (SummitBridge), Ben (Redwood finance).
- Week 1 (by 2027-06-28): Technical kickoff & infra access (VPC peering or dedicated sandbox) — Owners: Alex (SummitBridge infra), Aditya (Redwood infra).
- Week 2–5 (07/05–08/02): Pilot run — Owners: SummitBridge analytics team / Redwood SRE.
- Week 6 (by 2027-08-09): Evaluation, rubric review, and go/no-go to roll to production — Owners: SummitBridge PM + Redwood account exec.

Notes / asks from Redwood
- We attached a draft MPA and a short SOC 2 summary to speed the compliance review.
- Can you confirm the internal stakeholders who will sign procurement and the expected procurement SLA?
- Please flag any date conflicts; we can compress the timeline if procurement can fast-track the intake.

Next steps
1) Priya — confirm procurement owner and typical review SLA (we'll update the MPA accordingly).
2) Alex — confirm technical point-of-contact and whether VPC peering or on-prem connector is preferred.
3) Redwood (Aditya/Ben) — prepare pilot SOW draft and updated cost model for the proposed workload.

Attachments: MPA_SummitBridge_v1.pdf, SOC2_summary.pdf

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0183

From: Alex Ramos <alex.ramos@summitbridge.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Priya Nair <priya.nair@summitbridge.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 7 Jun 2027 16:12:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Recap & MPA: SummitBridge pilot playbook, stakeholders, and timelines

Thanks, Neha — helpful summary. A few clarifications and requests after syncing with infra/procurement: 

1) Data residency: we are in the middle of a GDPR-ish contract with one of our EU customers; for the pilot we need to ensure (a) logs never leave our VPC without explicit agreement, and (b) we have access to audit logs for the trial. SOC 2 summary is useful — can you add a short note on what logs we would see in the pilot?

2) Dates: procurement has a normal 2-week intake; we can aim for sign-off by 2027-06-28 only if Redwood provides a one-page vendor intake packet (summary + security touchpoints). If Redwood can't provide that, procurement will shift sign-off to 2027-07-05. Can Redwood share that one-pager?

3) Technical POC: our infra lead (cc'd Priya) prefers VPC peering for the pilot; mention in the MPA that the infra option is VPC peering (preferred) with an alternate hosted connector.

4) I've attached our vendor checklist so you can see procurement's items.

We'll review the MPA and send edits inline. Once procurement confirms SLA we'll lock dates.

Thanks,
Alex
Director of Infrastructure | SummitBridge
alex.ramos@summitbridge.com
+1 (415) 777-4021

Attachment: SummitBridge_vendor_checklist.xlsx

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Ramos <alex.ramos@summitbridge.com>, Priya Nair <priya.nair@summitbridge.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 8 Jun 2027 09:40:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Recap & MPA: SummitBridge pilot playbook, stakeholders, and timelines

Appreciate the checklist, Alex — that helps. Two quick notes from the Redwood ops/procurement side: 

- We can produce the one-page vendor intake summary (security posture, hosting options, contact points) by EOD 2027-06-09. I'll attach a pilot SOW draft to the thread for your procurement team to review — SOW_pilot_draft.docx.

- Regarding logs: during the pilot we'll provide an audit log bundle that includes request-level metadata (timestamp, model variant, token counts, request/response latencies) and an ops-level summary (batching behavior, KV-cache hits). We'll explicitly exclude any customer PII fields unless you opt into a scoped ingest test; that will be documented in the SOW.

Proposal to keep momentum:
- Redwood to deliver vendor one-pager + SOW draft by 2027-06-09.
- SummitBridge procurement to confirm intake SLA (either 6/28 sign-off or 7/05 fallback) by 2027-06-10.
- Tech kickoff target: 2027-06-29 (if 6/28 procurement OK) or 2027-07-06 (fallback).

If those dates work for you, we'll push the MPA -> DocuSign-ready copy and provide a cost model for the pilot configuration (dedicated sandbox with burst policy) the same day.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Director, Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai

Attachment: SOW_pilot_draft.docx

From: Alex Ramos <alex.ramos@summitbridge.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Nair <priya.nair@summitbridge.com>
Date: Wed, 9 Jun 2027 09:18:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Recap & MPA: SummitBridge pilot playbook, stakeholders, and timelines

All right — that timeline looks reasonable. Priya confirmed procurement can target the 2027-06-28 sign-off if we get your one-pager + SOW by Wednesday EOD. She also confirmed VPC peering is the preferred infra approach.

Action items we agree on now:
- Redwood (Ben/Aditya) — deliver the vendor one-pager, SOW draft, and updated MPA with "VPC peering preferred" language by 2027-06-09 EOD.
- SummitBridge (Priya) — confirm procurement sign-off timeline (target 2027-06-28) by 2027-06-10.
- Both teams — target tech kickoff 2027-06-29 if procurement closes on 6/28.

Once we have the updated MPA, we'll do a final read and then I'll route to legal for a quick vendor intake sign-off. If everything is clear we'll ask you to send a DocuSign intent link and we can get moving.

Thanks — looking forward,
Alex
